Markets.title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
Markets.summary: Yes Bank has asked the Supreme Court to review an October 15 order that upheld a Bombay High Court ruling quashing the write-off of Rs 8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds. The High Court had previously determined that the bank's administrator lacked the authority to write off these bonds during the bank's financial crisis.

Markets.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
Markets.summary: RHI Magnesita reported a 62 percent jump in net profit to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The company's consolidated revenues reached Rs 1,038.26 crore while overall expenses decreased compared to the previous year.

Markets.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
Markets.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has filed a Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering to raise nearly Rs 9,500 crore. The proposed IPO involves parent company Coal India selling a 10 percent stake, consisting of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty bulls overcome key resistance levels?
Markets.summary: The Nifty's technical setup has improved significantly after a sharp rebound near its 200-week moving average. However, the index is currently approaching key overhead resistance levels.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: An analysis identified eight stocks that recorded gains for five consecutive days. These equities generated cumulative returns between 7% and 11% over the period.

Markets.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
Markets.summary: Binance plans to fully reopen withdrawals for all assets and networks by the end of next week. The exchange is restoring operations after recovering 95% of the $6.3 billion lost in an October hack attributed to North Korean actors.

Geo-Political.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
Geo-Political.summary: The U.S. transport secretary stated that a nationwide flight suspension was caused by a copper wire upgrade. The federal government is investigating whether the incident resulted from faulty equipment or incompetence.

Geo-Political.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the US proposed Ukraine ceding the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership. While the US has not confirmed these specific remarks, a US official acknowledged that various ideas continue to be discussed.

Geo-Political.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
Geo-Political.summary: Italy has fined Meta 805 million euros for failing to inform 20 million users that the company accessed their photos. The regulatory penalty addresses a lack of transparency regarding user data privacy on the social media platform.

Geo-Political.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX successfully caught the returning booster stage of its Starship rocket using mechanical arms called chopsticks. This historic maneuver marks a major milestone in the company's development of fully reusable rocket systems.

Geo-Political.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
Geo-Political.summary: Carmelle won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia representing the Philippines. She secured the victory with her women's empowerment anthem titled "Sobra-Sobra."

Geo-Political.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
Geo-Political.summary: Heirs are challenging the Sotheby's auction of a $180 million Van Gogh painting, claiming the artwork was originally sold under duress. Sotheby's stated it is working with the family to reach a solution.

Data & Insights.title: Indian solar manufacturers look to Germany as China proposes curbs on technology exports
Data & Insights.summary: China is proposing curbs on solar technology exports that could negatively impact India's goal of building a domestic solar manufacturing ecosystem. Specifically, these restrictions threaten India's projection to reach 100 gigawatts of capacity for wafers, ingots, and polysilicon by the end of the decade.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to record imports. Although both exports and imports showed strong growth, the increase in imports significantly outpaced export growth.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: Retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit. This increase surpassed the 6% two-year high estimated by a Mint poll of 15 economists.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to assure investors of policy continuity and incentives. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu also intends to implement reforms to accelerate business and economic growth in the state.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The agency expects the country to sustain this growth rate through 2028, driven by domestic demand and economic resilience.

India.title: AI Helps Reunite Missing Maharashtra Woman With Family After 2.5 Years
India.summary: Artificial intelligence helped reunite a missing Maharashtra woman with her family after she had been separated from them for two and a half years. Her husband traveled to the Sanvita Ashram on November 9 to bring her back home following a phone call.

India.title: 2 Buses Of Punjab Pilgrimage Scheme Collide, 5 Killed In Tarn Taran
India.summary: Five people were killed in Punjab's Tarn Taran district when two buses from a pilgrimage scheme collided. The crash occurred after one bus driver crossed the road divider to avoid hitting a motorcycle and hit the oncoming bus.

India.title: "Where We Offered Namaz For 400 Years": Asaduddin Owaisi On Akhilesh Yadav's Ayodhya Ram Temple Visit
India.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi questioned Akhilesh Yadav's visit to the Ayodhya Ram Temple by highlighting the long history of Muslims offering prayers there. During a rally in Meerut, Owaisi also used the Samajwadi Party's 'PDA' slogan to mock the new alliance between his party and Chandrashekhar Azad's ASP.

India.title: Man Seen Eating Dead Dog's Entrails On Highway, Locals Seek Aid For Him
India.summary: Locals on an Indian highway discovered a man sitting beside a dog's carcass and consuming its flesh. Residents are now seeking medical and social aid for the individual.

India.title: Influencer Arrested Over 10.5 kg Madurai Gold Heist. She Knew Where Jewels Were
India.summary: An influencer was arrested by Madurai City Police for her involvement in a 10.5 kg gold heist. Investigators stated she had planned the robbery after visiting the jewellery showroom multiple times to locate the jewels.

India.title: Amit Shah Interacts With IPS Trainees, Interaction Focuses On National Security
India.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah met with newly trained Indian Police Service officers. The discussion centered on national security and building public trust in law enforcement.
